Hi Liam — thanks for the clear summary and the PO. Short answer: we support both flows; recommended path depends on your AP systems.

Recommendations and notes:
- If your AP system can ingest a single monthly statement (many ERPs can), consolidated monthly statement reduces transaction noise and is easiest for headcount-limited teams. We can produce a single PDF with invoice attachments and a CSV reconciliation export.
- If you need invoices immediately for automated matching to POs in your system, choose immediate per-invoice PDF push and we can also POST an invoice webhook to your endpoint.
- VAT evidence: for EU entities (Ireland) we can attach per-invoice VAT certificate (you can upload to the portal) or include VAT detail on each invoice. For monthly statements we can provide an appended VAT summary and a copy of the VAT cert.
- Billing contacts: portal enrollment is optional and additive — you can enable portal later without re-onboarding. If you enroll, you get a canonical archive + tokenized access to past invoices (searchable).

Action items from our side if you go with consolidated monthly statement:
- We will set billing contact to the Dublin AP mailbox by default unless you tell us a named contact.
- We'll attach the VAT certificate to the July statement and include line-level VAT columns.
- Confirm whether you want a CSV reconciliation (yes/no) and whether PO numbers should be exposed as a separate column or embedded in description.

If you want immediate PDFs, we'll need the endpoint for webhook delivery and confirm allowed IPs for inbound.

I copied Kimberly and Connor to confirm internal routing (which team will own one-off vendor exceptions).

Best,
Diego Fernandez
Senior Sales Operations Manager
Redwood Inference
